headline: SILVER EXPLODES 7.4% AS GOLD-SILVER RATIO CRASHES TO 55 — Sixth Year of Supply Deficit Meets AI Solar Demand
snippet: Spot silver surged 7.4% on May 11 to trade above $85/oz, compressing the gold-silver ratio to 55 — a multi-year low. Supply deficits now entering their sixth consecutive year, combined with AI data-centre and solar-panel demand, are driving silver's sharp outperformance versus gold.

headline: BRIXTON METALS DRILLS 7,900 g/t SILVER PEAK AT ONTARIO COBALT CAMP — 13m Averaging 594 g/t in Untested Zone
snippet: Drill hole LM-26-350 cut 13.0 metres averaging 594 g/t silver at Cobalt, Ontario — including a 0.5m interval grading 7,900 g/t — one of the strongest intercepts returned to date at the Langis project. Brixton has drilled 13,845 metres in 68 holes so far in 2026 as it advances toward a maiden resource estimate targeting 60,000 metres total.

headline: BRUNSWICK DRILLS 123 METRES AT 0.72% Li2O IN JAMES BAY — Cesium Bonanza Adds Second Metal Stream to Quebec Pegmatite
snippet: Winter drilling at Anatacau Main in Quebec cut 123 metres at 0.72% Li2O including 17.7 metres at 1.10%, plus 11.8 metres at 1.84% Cs2O cesium — among the highest-grade cesium intercepts in the entire James Bay region. Fast-tracked metallurgical testing will evaluate pollucite recoverability, potentially unlocking a second payable critical mineral.

headline: IRAN CEASEFIRE CALLED 'GARBAGE': Gold Holds $4,717 as India Cuts Bullion Imports Over War Energy Costs
snippet: Gold held above $4,700/oz on May 11 even as Indian PM Modi publicly urged citizens to curb gold purchases, citing rising fuel costs from the US-Iran war. Trump labelled Iran's ceasefire counter-proposal 'garbage,' keeping the geopolitical safe-haven bid intact while silver producers reported strong Q1 output growth.

headline: GALIANO GOLD HITS 53m AT 3.9 g/t AND 32m AT 4.7 g/t AT ABORE — Ghana Underground Grows, Budget Expanded
snippet: Galiano Gold confirmed major high-grade underground extensions at the Abore deposit on its Asanko Gold Mine in Ghana, with new intercepts of 53m at 3.9 g/t Au and 32m at 4.7 g/t Au. The company expanded its 2026 exploration budget and began permitting for an underground exploration adit, targeting ground-breaking in early 2027.

headline: BARRICK AUTHORIZES $3.0B BUYBACK — Record $3,200/oz Margins Generate Cash Faster Than Company Can Spend
snippet: Barrick's board authorized a US$3.0 billion share repurchase — the largest in company history — after Q1 operating margins reached approximately $3,200/oz at prevailing gold prices. The announcement signals management confidence that free cash flow is sustainable even if gold retraces from current levels above $4,500.

headline: SILVER ONE'S 108Moz AgEq CANDELARIA CLEARS PFS MILESTONE — Drilling Complete, Resource Expansion Rig Arriving in July
snippet: Silver One completed core and auger drilling plus an airborne ZTEM geophysical survey at its Candelaria silver project in Nevada, clearing a key Pre-Feasibility Study milestone for a 108-million-ounce AgEq resource. Pit-slope modelling and metallurgical characterization are ongoing, with resource expansion drilling expected in late May and a second rig arriving in July.

headline: COPPER MINES SLASH OUTPUT: China Acid Ban + Iran Hormuz Blockade Push Chilean Supply Costs Up 44% in One Month
snippet: China's sulphuric acid export ban — compounding Hormuz-disrupted sulphur flows from the Middle East — has pushed Chilean mine-site acid prices up 44% in a single month, forcing heap-leach copper operations in Chile and the DRC to cut output. The dual supply shock adds a new cost layer atop an already 150,000-tonne annual copper market deficit.

headline: CHILE LITHIUM REVENUES UP 175% IN APRIL TO $498M — SQM-Codelco Ramp Drives $2.1B YTD Surge
snippet: Chile's April lithium exports hit $498 million — up 175.6% year-on-year — as the SQM-Codelco joint venture ramps production through 2026, with Q1 shipment volumes rising 25%. Year-to-date lithium export revenue reached $2.14 billion through April, reflecting surging global demand for battery-grade carbonate, hydroxide, and sulfate.

headline: URANIUM SPOT AT $86/lb 17-MONTH HIGH — US Domestic Production Timelines Accelerate as Utilities Lock In Long-Term Supply
snippet: Uranium spot prices held at $86/lb in mid-May — a 17-month high — as U.S. domestic ISR production timelines compress following the April 2026 commissioning of new facilities. Utility demand is intensifying as grid operators extend reactor lifetimes and major tech companies commit to small modular reactor contracts to power AI infrastructure.

headline: GOLD STOCKS TRAIL METAL BY 25 POINTS — Two Miners Priced as if Gold Were Still $3,000: Analyst Picks
snippet: With GDX lagging gold's 60% one-year gain by more than 25 percentage points, The Motley Fool identifies two mining equities whose valuations imply a gold price well below current spot. The thesis: record cash flow generation and expanding buyback programs are the catalysts for a sector rerating that most retail investors have already missed the setup for.

headline: CHINA IMPORTS 790+ TONNES OF SILVER IN EARLY 2026 — Solar and EV Demand Drive Tightest Supply Balance Since 2011
snippet: Frank Holmes's weekly SWOT analysis notes China imported more than 790 tonnes of silver in the first part of 2026, driven by solar panel manufacturing and EV production — creating what he calls the tightest supply-demand balance since 2011. The weakness side flags that gold producers still trade at a 10% discount to their historical EBITDA multiples despite posting record earnings.
